hotel_name: Capital O Altus Residency Near Aravali Biodiversity Park

positive_snippets:
Clean, hygienic and economic place to stay.
Staff is efficient and very well mannered. Hotel has wifi, generator backup.
Rooms and washrooms are cleaned everyday when requested.
Very well maintained place.
Food is good but on costlier side.
